sql: WITH receita_corrente AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS total_receita FROM receita_receita WHERE dsc_cateconomica ILIKE '%Corrente%' AND ano_referencia = 2024), despesa_corrente AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS total_despesa FROM despesa_despesa WHERE dsc_naturezadespesa ILIKE '3%' AND ano_referencia = 2024) SELECT total_receita / NULLIF(total_despesa, 0) AS isf_m FROM receita_corrente, despesa_corrente;
